_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec. TSK_WNSC_* not in context_prefixes_in_use — no collision. Combined prime+paint spec (primer conditional on substrate_state). Domain: interior, context: NC. SF-based wainscot panel assembly measurement. wainscot_type (flat_panel/raised_panel/beadboard) is a configuration dimension driving complexity modifier.

paintable_items.name: Wainscot panel assembly
paintable_items.notes: Single SF item for entire assembly (panels + internal rails/stiles + base rail + applied molding). Measured as wall area covered by wainscot system below cap rail. Internal framing complexity captured by wainscot_type modifier.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_WNSC_* not in context_prefixes_in_use.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_WNSC_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (FLOOR_PROTECT, WALL_MASK, DUST_CLEAN, SAND_PREP, FILL_FASTENERS, CAULK_JOINTS, CAULK_WALL, SEAL_MDF_EDGES, PRIME_FACES, FINISH_SPRAY, FINISH_BRUSH, SAND_BETWEEN, INSPECT_COAT, FINAL_INSPECT, REMOVE_PROTECTION, VACUUM)

expected_modules.description: Floor protection, wall masking above cap rail (spray only), staging
Dust wipe, sand per substrate/QT, fill fastener holes, caulk panel-to-frame joints, caulk wainscot-to-wall junction, MDF edge seal (bare MDF only)
Primer coat — conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE. Primer type driven by substrate (MDF two-step, FJP stain-block, softwood standard, hardwood tannin-block).
Finish coat application. Spray: panels first, then frame detail. Brush: panel-to-frame sequence.
Between-coat inspect, sand, repair — universal at ALL quality tiers. Rigid block sanding per FFD §15.4.1.
Final quality check. Visual inspection at tier-appropriate distance. Check holidays at panel-to-frame junctions.
Protection teardown, floor vacuum, tool cleaning.

module_prefix.notes: Combined prime+paint spec. Prime module conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE. No internal component sequencing needed — single SF item.

paintscope_keys.description: Total SF of wainscot panel assembly below cap rail. Defined in Millwork Doctrine §1.1 but not yet active in PaintScope catalog.
Floor protection area at wainscot work zone.
Wall masking LF above wainscot cap rail line. Spray only.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 not applicable — wainscot is prominent millwork per Millwork Doctrine.

application_method.notes: Spray preferred for NC production — large flat panels spray efficiently. Brush for occupied spaces, small areas, or touch-up.

wainscot_type.notes: Drives production rate complexity modifier: flat_panel=1.0×, raised_panel=1.25×, beadboard=1.15×. Per Millwork Doctrine §7.2.

sheen.notes: Sheen/QT gate: satin at QT3+, semi-gloss at QT4+, gloss at QT5 only. Satin default for softer wainscot appearance.

substrate_state.notes: SS_BARE requires primer (substrate-driven chemistry). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer. Standard NC delivery is factory-primed.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF for wainscot panel tasks. EA_ROOM for room-level setup/cleanup. LF for protection masking. FIXED for tool cleanup.

product_role.notes: Combined prime+paint spec. Sealer for MDF edge sealing (solvent-based).

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline, QT4/QT5=selective_multiplier on qt_scaled tasks, QT5 brush=additional_rounds.

surface_ids.notes: wainscot_panel exists in Surface_Vocabulary_Reference.md Millwork Surfaces section but not yet in id_registry active entries. All adjacent surface IDs are existing.

zone_ids.notes: Drop cloth runners at base of wainscot work area.
Paper masking above cap rail line — spray only.

primer_systems.name: Solvent-based MDF edge sealer
primer_systems.notes: Reuse from SF_STAIR_RISER_NC. Step 1 of two-step MDF prime.

primer_systems.name: High-build latex face primer for MDF
primer_systems.notes: Reuse from SF_STAIR_RISER_NC. Step 2 of two-step MDF prime.

primer_systems.name: Stain-blocking primer for FJP/poplar
primer_systems.notes: Reuse from SF_STAIR_RISER_NC. MANDATORY for bare FJP.

primer_systems.name: Acrylic wood primer for softwood
primer_systems.notes: Reuse from SF_WINDOW_INT_NC. Standard acrylic primer-sealer for bare softwood wainscot. Brief proposed SYS_PRIMER_WOOD_STANDARD_WAINSCOT but SYS_PRIMER_WOOD_ACRYLIC covers the same product category — REUSE OVER CREATION.

material_system_prefix.notes: All material systems reuse existing IDs. 3 finish systems (SYS_FF_*) + 5 primer systems (SYS_PRIMER_*). No new system IDs needed. Material systems are recommendations — contractor has discretion.

proposed_for_this_spec.description: Wainscot panel finish coat coverage rate

cross_spec_coordination.notes: No cross-spec flags. Wainscot panel work pairs with SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT for shared finish group (cap rail, baseboard) and SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH for wall above.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup > prep > prime > apply > interstage > finish > cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: TSK_ prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules and production
RULE 10: ITM_ IDs marked existing in resolution.json MUST use exact registered ID in spec.json
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values in resolution.json applicable_enums
